description: This file defines a PHP class 'EAPMViewDetail' which extends 'ViewDetail'. It handles displaying a detailed view of a user-related module in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including managing the module's title, icons, navigation, and access control.
external_files: ViewDetail (likely part of the CRM framework)

classes.name: EAPMViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending the ViewDetail component to display detailed user module information, including navigation, icons, and access checks.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the module tab name, fixed to 'Users'.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Builds and returns parameters for the module title, including icons, links, and names, customized based on request parameters.

methods.name: getModuleTitleIconPath
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return the icon path for the 'Users' module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares the user data (e.g., password placeholder), assigns return id, and displays the detail view if the user has permissions; otherwise, shows no access message.
